title: Console hint palette: contextual templates for dashboards, rollouts, and cost views
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and prototype a lightweight, context-aware 'hint palette' for the Redwood Console to reduce time-to-first-success across dashboards, rollout pages, and cost views. The palette surface is a micro-template library and tooltip system that surfaces suggested templates, short guided actions, and one-click starter configurations when users land on empty or low-data pages. Goals: reduce user confusion in empty states, increase creation of dashboards and rollouts by new users, surface cost-saving recommendations in cost views, and provide a low-friction path to sample data / templates without breaking platform guardrails.
comments: 2026-02-20 - Initial ticket created after product kick-off meeting. Captured requirements from PM: target new sign-ups + teams with low activity; connect templates to Console blueprints and runtime recommendations.
2026-02-26 - Early wireframes (sketch) reviewed with Eng. Engineering flagged performance impact of live template previews; agreed to use static snapshots for v1.
2026-03-02 - Usability session planned with 6 participants (mix of PLG sign-ups and internal devs). Research script drafted: measure time-to-create-dashboard and comprehension of rollout templates.
2026-03-05 - Design critique: prefer palette docked to page header vs. modal. Decided on docked micro-panel (less disruptive) with a single dismiss action and "always show" toggle in settings.
2026-03-09 - Accessibility review notes: ensure keyboard focus trap for walkthrough mode disabled; maintain ARIA labels for template cards; validate color contrast for hint badges.
2026-03-10 - Submitted Figma prototype and passive front-end spike ticket. Moving to In Review for design handoff and final copy polish.
design_assets: Figma: Draft prototype (v3) - docked palette with template cards
PNG: empty-state mocks - dashboards / rollouts / cost-view
Prototype: In-browser clickable (flows: Apply Template, Start Walkthrough, Dismiss)
decisions: Palette type: docked micro-panel in header area (non-modal) to avoid interrupting keyboard flows
Template tiers: (1) Quick Actions (single-click create), (2) Starter Templates (prefilled forms), (3) Walkthroughs (step-by-step interactive)
Preview strategy: static lightweight snapshots for v1; live previews deferred to v2 due to GPU/runtime cost concerns
Analytics: instrument 'template_shown', 'template_applied', 'walkthrough_started', 'dismissed' events for funnel analysis
Rollout: A/B test with 10% of new sign-ups vs control; success metrics = time-to-first-dashboard, template application rate, 7-day retention
